Product Details: The Kärcher K1900PS is a powerful and efficient electric pressure washer designed for deep cleaning around your home and property. With a 2375 max. PSI output and a maximum GPM of 1.46, this power washer effortlessly tackles everything from patios and decks to cars, sidewalks, and siding. The kit includes three different spray nozzles with a universal quick-connect fitting: a 15° nozzle for regular cleaning tasks, a turbo nozzle for intense cleaning power, and a 65° soap nozzle for applying detergent and achieving a sparkling finish. The integrated detergent tank on the top of the unit makes it easy to apply your favorite pressure washer detergents. For added convenience, the detergent tank is removable to fill and clean when needed. Thanks to the three different nozzles, the K1900PS can be used to clean vehicles, concrete, decks, and much more. The integrated storage container on the back of the unit keeps the trigger gun, hose, and stainless steel spray wand stored away while not in use, ensuring everything stays organized. The nozzles can be secured on the handle when not in use, so you never misplace one ever again. Keep the power cord neatly organized using the cord wrap on the handle, where you can also store the power plug. To minimize the storage space, fold down the handle. The portable power washer features never-flat tires, so you can transport and use the unit anywhere on your property. No tools are needed for the assembly of the K1900PS, so you can start cleaning as soon as it arrives. The on/off foot switch provides easy power control, allowing you to turn the pressure washer on and off with a simple tap of your foot. Water flow is controlled separately through the trigger gun. This set includes the K1900PS, a pressure washer gun, a stainless steel spray wand, a 15° nozzle, a 65° nozzle, a turbo nozzle, an adapter for 3/4"" garden hose, a removable detergent tank, and a M22 20 ft. pressure washer hose.
